:::{#thm-weibull-ph-aft}
#### A Weibull proportional hazards model is an AFT model

Let $\surv_0(t) = \expf{-(\lambda t)^p}$ be a Weibull baseline survival function
with scale $\lambda > 0$ and shape $p > 0$.
If subject $i$ has hazard $\haz_0(t) \cdot \theta_i$
for a constant $\theta_i > 0$,
then subject $i$'s survival function is

$$
\surv_i(t) = \surv_0\paren{ t \cdot \theta_i^{1/p} },
$$

so the model is also an accelerated failure time model,
with acceleration factor $\theta_i^{1/p}$.

:::
